newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine sets goal of 10-12 pct inflation for 1998.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sets goal of 10-12 pct inflation for 1998.

text.p: Ukraine plans to bring annual inflation down to 10-12 percent for 1998 from a predicted 25 percent this year, President Leonid Kuchma told industrial leaders late on Tuesday.
Kuchma said the government would continue to implement tight monetary policy to slow inflation from 1997 levels.
"We have no alternative but to lower inflation," he said.
Inflation was 39.7 percent in 1996, down from 181 percent in 1995. January monthly inflation is forecast at 2.5 percent, after 0.9 percent in December and 1.2 percent in November.
